name: zotero-study-save
description: Save approved ChatGPT study questions, explanations, proofs, and references as passage-linked native Zotero annotations.

interface.longDescription: Study an arXiv paper already saved in Zotero, then save requested highlights, questions, explanations, proofs, and references beside the relevant PDF passage.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read this arXiv paper from the PDF already saved in Zotero and study it with me.
